_about: Live limitations of this corpus that affect the numbers the benchmark publishes. Fixed issues are not listed — they are fixed. Issues that do not affect the metrics in use are not listed either.

_severity.blocks: these documents cannot be scored on that leg at all
_severity.weakens: scored, but the result is less informative than it looks
_severity.noted: a property to know when reading results, not a defect

limitations.summary: Ground truth for these 11 documents was generated by Tesseract when the corpus was built, and is too unreliable to score against (42-66% of the page content is missing from it).
limitations.effect: They contribute no text scores and are evaluated by the LLM judge instead. Re-transcription was attempted and declined: the newspapers are multi-column pages of several thousand words, report_001 is a rotated dense numeric table and report_002 a handwritten ledger. Transcribing those by model would introduce more error than it removes.

limitations.summary: Nineteen pages have model-transcribed, model-reviewed or partially repaired text references. Eight have historical engine-consensus checks. Six invoice references were rechecked against their images, and five receipts have targeted source-image-reviewed corrections to address omissions, label typos and a duplicated annotation.
limitations.effect: These are not independent human annotations. Invoice and receipt corrections are based on source-image inspection, not new engine-consensus checks. The model_verified category discloses this provenance and does not certify every character. Receipt repairs are partial: remaining tokenization, handwriting and ambiguous characters need separate review. See documents/gt_provenance.json and per-result repair metadata.

limitations.summary: Source datasets ship schemas scoped to the task they were built for, not to extraction — SROIE provides four fields where its receipts carry roughly twenty-five extractable values. These 17 documents were re-annotated from the images so the leg can actually distinguish engines.
limitations.effect: Most fields here are model-annotated rather than dataset-annotated; each file records field provenance. Historical corroboration is not a complete source-image validation: the 2026-10-02 audit found chart_003 quantitative series were copied from approximate and visibly incorrect source annotations. Those branches are now excluded at load time for every engine; printed axes, legends and titles remain. Other reference-review candidates are tracked in docs/handoff-2026-10-01.md. The sroie_002 PAID stamp was separately confirmed by a human.

limitations.summary: Schemas follow the shape of the document. A tax form nests values under line numbers (income.line1.b, .d, .g), a receipt is flat plus a line-item array, a bank statement is a holdings table.
limitations.effect: Field accuracy is comparable between engines on the same document, and not comparable across document types — a 43-field tax form and a 20-field receipt are not the same difficulty. Aggregate per document type; never pool into one schema number.

limitations.summary: Each handwriting page is fifteen consecutive IAM line images composited onto a white canvas.
limitations.effect: The handwriting and its transcript are genuine, so these measure handwriting recognition fairly. The page layout is synthetic, so they do not represent real handwritten-document layout.

limitations.summary: These 6 markdown references were originally derived from the dataset's parsed_data and used its schema field names ('invoice_date', 'seller_tax_id', 'item_net_price') as labels where the page prints 'Date of issue', 'Tax Id', 'Net price'. They have been re-transcribed from the page images: printed labels, the page's own 8-column ITEMS header, the SUMMARY rendered as the table it is, and no invented headings.
limitations.effect: The page-transcribed references replaced schema vocabulary that was never printed. The 2026-10-02 source audit also excludes unreadable replacement-glyph spans in invoice_004 item 3 and invoice_005 item 1 rather than preserving guessed zero/O characters. These readable transcriptions now supply the text reference as well; original sidecars remain unchanged.

limitations.summary: These table references were generated from the invoices' markdown GT while that GT still used the source dataset's schema field names, and carried six columns where the page prints eight (No. and UM were absent). They have been rebuilt from the page-transcribed markdown.
limitations.effect: The wrong reference capped every engine at the same score and hid all differences between them: mistral_ocr, paddleocr_vl, glm_ocr, mineru, deepseek_ocr and docling all scored 0.585-0.587 on invoice_000. Against the rebuilt reference the same stored outputs score 1.000, 1.000, 1.000, 1.000, 1.000 and 0.999, with marker at 0.922 — an actual ranking. Rebuilt 2026-08-09; funsd_002/003/004 use the same derivation but their markdown GT transcribes printed labels, so they were unaffected.

limitations.summary: Table references for these 5 documents had been generated from schema field names rather than the columns printed on the page, and have been removed rather than left in place — a wrong reference scores worse than none.
limitations.effect: chart_002 and chart_004 print charts, not tables, so no table reference is applicable and they are correctly out of the table leg. photo_001, photo_002 and photo_004 do have printed line-item tables; a reference transcribed from the page would restore them. The table leg now covers 40 documents.

limitations.summary: The chart has no printed bar-segment counts. Approximate data tables in the source transcription are not OCR text, and some counts disagree visibly with the bars.
limitations.effect: The versioned loader uses source-verified printed chart text and excludes employmentLevelBreakdown, ageAndGenderBreakdown and workforceByGender from schema references and future request contracts. Figures, printed axes/legends, page/footer and the largest sector remain. Quantitative chart interpretation needs a separately verified reference and estimation tolerance. Archived sidecars and historical scores remain unchanged.

limitations.summary: Invoice_004 item 3 and invoice_005 item 1 end in replacement glyphs whose underlying characters cannot be recovered from the shipped image. Earlier references guessed zeros/O characters or arrows.
limitations.effect: Score the readable prefixes in text, Markdown and tables. Exclude the two complete description fields from schema exact-value scoring, before sampling; other fields remain scored. Invoice_005 item 5 has a separate verified slash correction. All engines receive the same reference treatment, with exclusions recorded in structured_reference_repairs.

limitations.summary: Five SROIE references required readable address suffixes missing from both text and line-box labels. Targeted repairs preserve original sidecars and every retained coordinate. Other receipt content has not been independently reannotated.
limitations.effect: sroie_002 first faded address line has an unreadable suffix: readable prefix remains in text; its full-line box is excluded from geometry. sroie_003 duplicated TOTAL QTY box is counted once. sroie_000 structured shoe code is B05, as printed, not 805. The repairs do not settle punctuation/spacing sensitivity, handwriting omissions, ambiguous registration digits or other unreviewed structured fields. A separate source review repairs sroie_003 to one purchased item with a two-line description, removing three nonexistent blank fields. Schema field coverage does not independently penalize every extra engine row; full returned arrays remain necessary evidence.
